fusions.name: Fistful Feast
fusions.desc: Takes a bite from every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 6 damage and restores 3 health to you. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cloud Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a clump of insects that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Stripped Field
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm that stays for 14 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge on the Fallen
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
